title: Automated Consultant Availability Management
business: Independent boutique consulting firms managing high-volume client intake.
problem: Consultants lose billable hours manually updating Calendly event types and checking availability across fragmented calendar views when client project scopes shift.
solution: By integrating the Calendly connector, consultants use Claude to programmatically query availability schedules and update event type parameters, ensuring that booking windows reflect real-time project capacity without manual dashboard navigation.
steps: Authenticate the Calendly connector within the Claude interface to grant access to user event types.
Invoke event_types-list_event_types to identify the specific consulting session event ID.
Use availability-list_user_availability_schedules to retrieve current blocking rules.
Execute event_types-update_event_type_availability_schedule to refine the booking window based on new project constraints.
outcome: Consultants achieve a fluid scheduling workflow where administrative overhead is minimized, allowing for immediate adjustments to availability as project demands evolve.
limitation: The connector operates on the current user's permissions, meaning it cannot modify availability for other team members or shared organization calendars. Users must verify changes by checking the returned event object status to ensure the API successfully committed the update.
